audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers showed Karma, Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, Karma, K'Sante, K'Sante — five rows contradicting the packet chart and the already-audited mirror (karma__ksante), which is Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Skill, Karma, K'Sante.
audit.why: 49.1% over 2438 games with the mirror already locked; the prose in whys[1..5] already describes Karma winning those stages, so only the tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Skill, Karma, K'Sante in phases[].side and win[] together, ratings inverted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why sold Iceborn Gauntlet as a fight-forcing spike against a 950-range poke enchanter.
audit.why: Inner Flame is 950 range and Inspire (E, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) shields and move-speeds her out of every W; a first tank item does not close that.
audit.corrected: First-item row rewritten as Karma's, with her 950 range and Inspire named. Level 6 remains the K'Sante swing (All Out, R 120/100/80s), phases[4] rewritten to say why it is only even.
sources: kit: Karma Q range 950, E cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8

audit.whatIsWrong: Repeated 'Q3-knockup' — K'Sante's Q has no third-cast knockup; at 2 stacks of Ntofo Strikes it fires a shockwave that PULLS. Also 'W's unstoppable charge' asserts unstoppable, which Riot's text does not say (it says reduced damage taken).
audit.why: Kit text is authority; unstoppable status is not in the file, so it is unknown and must not be asserted.
audit.corrected: All Q3-knockup instances in the writable paths changed to the two-stack Ntofo Strikes pull; W described as charge-up damage reduction. Grievous Wounds added against Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve's heal.
sources: kit: K'Sante Q 'At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in'
kit: K'Sante W 'charges up, taking reduced damage'
kit: Karma W Mantra Bonus 'healing herself'

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal mention despite Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve healing her through extended trades.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds added to the itemization row.
